subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should public docs.openclaw.ai track latest stable releases by default, stay latest-main with explicit version availability markers, or rely on bundled/version-matched docs for release-specific guidance?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the durable fix changes docs publishing and release policy rather than a single code path.

options.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
options.body: Publish or label docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before the release that accepts them.

options.title: Keep latest-main docs with recovery
options.body: Keep docs as latest-main but add prominent latest-only/version markers plus version-aware config validation or doctor recovery.

options.title: Defer to bundled docs track
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 as the main product track and keep this issue as the public-docs policy reminder until that direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
recommendation.body: Publish or label docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before the release that accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: He is connected to the current docs/config drift example and recent docs publish workflow changes.
